en:
## New Features

- Added an example external provider plugin that runs alongside the built-in adapter under its own prefix and credential store, so the built-in implementation can eventually be removed without a migration step
- The narrator message list gained an LOD indicator, shown while Alt is held over that panel's message area so side-by-side panels only light up the one under the pointer
- Jumping to a message is no longer limited to the loaded window: the virtual list pages backwards until it covers the target, and when it cannot reach it, says whether the history genuinely lacks it or the search ran out of budget
- Notification sounds gained a master volume and a cap on simultaneous playback; notifications past the cap are dropped rather than queued
- Stable releases now also publish a direct upgrade patch from the previous stable version, so stable users no longer have to apply the whole chain of intermediate beta patches

## Improvements

- Your proxy setting is now the only thing that decides whether a request is proxied. Bun's `fetch` silently honours an ambient `HTTP(S)_PROXY` even when a request asks for a direct connection, so choosing "direct" globally or per provider could still route traffic through whatever proxy your shell exported, with no sign of it in the UI
- Your own tools keep your proxy configuration: terminals, the agent's Bash tool, git remote operations, podman, project startup scripts and MCP servers all still see the environment they would see outside NarraFork
- A self-update no longer loses your system proxy. Previously, "system" proxy mode silently fell back to direct connections after every update until the whole process was restarted from a shell

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed plugin installation being impossible on Windows: ZIP archives are now read and unpacked in-process instead of shelling out to `unzip`, which does not exist there. Archives whose entry names carry a `./` prefix install again as well
- Fixed sessions being permanently stuck after an interrupted stream left an empty reasoning block in the history, which every later turn then failed on at the same index
- Fixed reasoning blocks replayed without a signature being rejected as an invalid parameter combination
- Fixed Codex requests carrying a sticky-routing token on a transport that never returns it, and a stale request snapshot being resent on reconnect, which silently disabled incremental continuation and prompt caching
- Fixed Codex sending a header whose contract requires a different request body, which strict endpoints rejected with a 400 tool error
- Fixed retried gateway adapter requests looking like separate first-time calls to the upstream, causing adaptive throttling to underestimate the real load
- Fixed queued messages being stranded forever after a restart when the recovery round contained only background agents
- Fixed graceful restart hanging when a proxy synthesised an HTTP error, which is not the authoritative shutdown signal
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 新增外部提供商插件示例，与内置适配器并存（独立的前缀与凭据存储），使内置实现日后可整体移除而无需迁移步骤
- 叙述者消息列表新增 LOD 指示器：按住 Alt 且指针位于该面板消息区时显示，并排面板下只点亮当前面板
- 跳转到消息不再局限于已加载窗口：目标位于更早历史时会向上翻页直至覆盖它；无法到达时会区分「历史确实没有」与「超出本次搜索预算」，而不是静默不动
- 通知声音新增主音量与同时播放上限，超出上限的通知直接丢弃而不堆积
- 正式版发布时会额外生成「上一个正式版 → 该版本」的直达升级包，正式版用户不必再连续应用中间 beta 的整条 patch 链

## 改进

- 代理设置现在是决定请求是否走代理的唯一依据。Bun 的 `fetch` 即便在请求明确要求直连时也会读取环境里的 `HTTP(S)_PROXY`，因此此前选择全局或按提供商「直连」，流量仍可能被送进 shell 导出的代理，界面上毫无迹象
- 你自己的工具保留你的代理配置：终端、agent 的 Bash 工具、git 远程操作、podman、项目启动脚本和 MCP 服务器看到的环境，与在 NarraFork 之外一致
- 自更新不再丢失系统代理。此前「跟随系统代理」模式在每次更新后会静默退化为直连，且只能从 shell 重启整个进程才能恢复

## 修复

- 修复 Windows 上无法安装插件：ZIP 归档改为进程内读取和解压，不再依赖该平台不存在的 `unzip` 命令；条目名带 `./` 前缀的归档也能重新安装
- 修复中断的流在历史里留下空思考块后会话被永久卡死，此后每一轮都在同一索引失败
- 修复重放缺少签名的思考块时被判为「请求参数组合无效」
- 修复 Codex 把粘性路由标识放在了永远拿不回它的传输层上，以及重连时重发建连前的旧请求快照，导致增量续写与 prompt 缓存静默失效
- 修复 Codex 发送了一个要求配套不同请求体的头，被严格端点以 400 工具错误拒绝
- 修复内置网关适配器的重试被上游视为多次独立的首次调用，导致自适应限流低估真实压力
- 修复重启后恢复轮次仅含后台 agent 时，排队消息永久无人消费
- 修复经由代理时合成的 HTTP 错误被当作关停信号，导致优雅重启卡住
